headline: Reviewed preserveBTV grant report and held annual organizational meeting for 2027 board assignments.
summary: The board reviewed the CLG 2024 preserveBTV final grant report and asked members to send added comments to staff by August 4th. The board then held its annual organizational meeting to nominate and elect a Chair and Vice Chair and assign members to HPRC and the PC Ordinance Committee, with results shown in a 2027 assignments table.
